transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... work issues, I guess. I work in a meat processing plant, and... I just keep starting things like the sanitation steps, or the batch logs, and... I somehow just leave out the last parts. Same with the end-of-line paperwork. I know my job depends on finishing it all correctly, but... yeah. That's what brings me in.
Do you find yourself having trouble focusing on tasks outside of work as well?

Um... I don't really know about outside of work. I mostly just notice it at the plant. Like... even when I start my shift trying really hard to stay locked in, after a while, it all just kind of blurs together. The cutting, the weighing, checking the labels... I'll just realize I've been staring at the same tray or log sheet for a while. Just... not taking in what I'm actually supposed to do next.
Do you often forget things that happened during your shift at the plant?
Um... I don't think so. I mean, I remember being there. It's just... the tasks don't get finished. But I don't really forget what actually happens.
Do you feel anxious or overwhelmed when you're at work and struggling to complete tasks?
Um... I don't really know. I guess I just... I don't really feel much of anything. It's just frustrating that the work isn't done. I just want to do my job.
Do you feel sad or down most of the time?
Um... no. I don't think so. I don't really feel sad.
Do you feel like you're going through the motions of daily life without much emotional involvement?
Um... I don't really know. I just... I go to the plant, do my shift, and go home. I don't really think about it like that. It's just my day, I guess.
Do you feel like things that normally would upset or excite you don't have much of an effect on you lately?
Um... no, not really. I mean, if something happens, I still react to it. I haven't really noticed any kind of change like that.
Do you feel like you're emotionally disconnected from the people or activities in your life?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I still talk to people at work and stuff. I don't think I feel disconnected.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety, like you can't sit still?
Um... no. I don't think so. I mean, I stand a lot at work anyway, but... when I do sit, I just sit. I don't really feel restless.
Do you feel like you're unable to experience emotions like happiness or excitement?
No... I don't think so. I still feel happy when good things happen, I guess. I haven't noticed anything like that.
Do you feel like you're unable to feel upset or angry when something bad happens?
No, I... I get upset if something goes wrong. I mean, if there's a problem, I feel it. It's not like I don't care.
Do you feel like you're less concerned about making mistakes at work than you used to be?
No, I don't think so. I still care about doing my job right. I don't want to mess up the cuts or anything. So... no, I haven't noticed that changing.
Do you find yourself avoiding certain tasks or situations at work because they feel too difficult or overwhelming?

I mean... yeah, I guess. Mostly just... the certification modules. Or any of the long procedure reading. I kind of... I put them off until the last possible minute. Just sitting there, trying to absorb all those rules... it feels almost physically exhausting. So... yeah.
Have you noticed any changes in your relationships with friends or family members recently?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, things are pretty much the same with them. I haven't really noticed any big changes.
Do you ever feel like you're outside of your body, watching yourself do things?
No... I don't think I've ever felt like that. That sounds... strange. I just feel like myself, I guess.
Do you ever feel mentally foggy or confused during your shift at the plant?
Um... no. Not really foggy or... confused. I just... I do my job. It's mostly just cutting and packing, so... I don't really get confused doing it.
Do you ever feel disconnected from what's happening around you?
Um... no. Not really. I'm just... there, I guess. I don't really know what you mean by disconnected, but... no.
Do you ever feel like you're not really experiencing things that are happening to you?
Um... no. I don't think so. I mean... if something happens, it's just happening to me. I don't really get that feeling.
Have you experienced any traumatic events recently or in the past that might be affecting your ability to focus at work?
Um... no. Nothing like that. I haven't... nothing traumatic has happened. Just... no.
Do you ever feel like you're doing things without being fully aware of what you're doing?
Um... no. I don't think so. I mean, I know what I'm doing when I'm doing it. I just... no, not really.
